name: Tasuketa Kemomimi Musume-tachi to Ichaicha Natsukarex Shimakuru Isekai FamiRes Hanjouki
original_name: 助けたけもみみ娘たちとイチャイチャ懐かれックスしまくる異世界ファミレス繁盛記
source:
After waking up in a foreign fantasy world, you are brought before a King who requests you set up an "Otherworldly Cafe" so that his citizens may partake in delicacies from another realm! 

On the day of the restaurant's grand opening, you encounter a sinister slaver corralling 2 animal-eared girls in the street:
- The easy-going dog-eared Primina.
- The timid and shy cat-eared Cherela.

And so you spend the money you were planning to use for ingredients to save the 2 girls instead! While the two girls are free to do as they please now that they are free, they really don't have anywhere else to go as people treat the demi-humans quite poorly. So you end up offering them jobs at your restaurant. 

As the three of you work together and deepen your bonds, enjoy a fluffy *tail* of comfy romance between yourself and your adorable coworkers in this isekai world!
